content: Ibrahimor Moron
Ibrahime ar ugguwa bou loiye, zar nam Keturah.
Hibaye hiballa Simron, Jokšan, Medan edde Midiyan, Išbak edde Šuah, itarare biyaiye.
Jokšane Šeba edde Dedan, itarare faiye; ar Dedanor bongšo okkol aššilde Asšuriyo, Letušiyo edde Leummiyo.
Ar Midiyanor futain okkol aššilde Efah, Efer, Hanok, Abida edde Eldaah. Itara beggun aššilde Keturar bongšo okkol.
Ibrahime hibar nizor hár kissu Isakore di giye.
Kintu Ibrahim basi taite, hibar bandi bouwaindor boitta hibar futain okkolore hadiya okkol diye, edde hibar fut Isakor hentu hitarare fuk mikka fuk dešot faṭai diye.
Ibrahimor zibonor bosoror din okkol oilde in: Hiba ekšo hoittor fãs bosor basi aššil.
Tarfore hibar boyoš oiyore edde beši bura boyošot šeš niyaš felaiye, edde hibar nizor manuš loi dola oiyegoi.
Hibar futain Isake edde Ismaile Mamrer sarme Hetittiyo Soharor fut Efronor maṭor Mokfelar gãtot hibare dohon diye,
ziyan Ibrahime Hetittiyo okkolottu kini loil, heṛe hibar bou Sarar fũwati Ibrahimore o dohon gora oiye.
Ibrahimor moron oi bade, hibar fut Isakore Allaye rahamot goijje. Ar Isak Beer Lahai Roir hãse bošobaš goijje.
Ismailor futain okkol
Iyan oilde Ibrahimor fut Ismailor bongšo kahani, zare Sarar Mišoriyo bandi Hazeraye Ibrahimolla biyail.
In okkol oilde Ismailor futaindor nam okkol, hitarar zormonamat nam okkol asede mozin:
Ismailor foila zormo Nebayot, Kedar, Adbeel edde Mibsam,
Mišma, Dumah, Massa,
Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Nafiš edde Kedmah.
In okkol aššide Ismailor futain okkol, edde hitarar fara okkol edde ṭambu okkol mozin itara oilde baro guštir sordar okkolor nam okkol.
Ismailor zibonor bosoror din okkol oilde in: Hiba ekšo tiriš hãt bosor basi aššil. Bade hibaye šeš niyaš felaiye edde mori giyegoi, ar hibar nizor manuš loi dola oiyegoi.
Ar Ismaili okkol Havilattu Šur foijjonto, ziyan Mišorottu Asšuror mikka, ei zaga okkolot bošobaš goijje, edde hitara hitarar hár sordar okkole ekku fũwati taki no fare.
Yakub edde Iš
In okkol oilde Ibrahimor fut Isakor bongšor kahani.
Ibrahim Isakor baf oiye,
ar sališ bosor boyošot Isake Paddanor Aramiyo Betuelor zi edde Aramiyo Labonor boin Rebekare biya goijje.
Ar Isake hibar bouwolla Mabudor hãse duwa goijje, kiyollahoile hiba bázá aššil. Mabude hibar duware goisse, edde Rebekah hamil oiye.
Bade hibar gorbor butore fuwainde dora dori diye edde hibaye hodde, "Ãttu endilla ka or?" Toi hibaye Mabudottu fusar goitto giye.
Mabude hibare hodde,

content.text: Tor udorottu loti dui zati alok oiya oibo;
Ek zati ar ek zatittuwaro beši šoktiwala oibo,

content: Bade zehon hibaye biyaibar ṭaim aišše, ar so, hibar górbot zoikka morod fuwain.
Ar foila niyoli aiššede hite lal, hitar hara ga kẽšša bazu ḍoilla, hetolla hitara hitar nam raikke Iš.
Tarfore hitar bái niyoli aišše hitar hate Išor formurit dori, hetolla hitar nam raka oiye Yakub. Isakor boyoš haiṭ bosor zẽtte Rebekaye itarare biyaiye.
Ei fuwain ḍõr oiye edde Iš ekzon maṛot takoya, ekzon beši bala šiyari goroya oiye, ar Yakub aššilde ekzon nizam manuš, ze ṭambut takito.
Isak šiyari gusto hána moza faito, hetolla Išore ador goijje, kintu Rebekaye Yakubore ador goijje.
Ekbar Yakube zul rãder, Iš horan ferešan oi maṛottu firi aišše.
Hite Yakubore hodde, "Toratori gor, oi lal zulottu ãre kissu haito de, kiyollahoile ãi horan oiyi." (Hetolla Išore Edom zar mani Lal o ḍakito.)
Kintu Yakube hodde, "Age tui ãre tor foila zormor odihargan besifela."
Išye hodde, "Sa, ãi mori zairgoi, foila zormor odihar loi ãi ki goijjium?"
Yakube hodde, "Tui aijja ãr loi hosom há." Henot hite hitar hãse hosom háiye, edde hitar foila zormor odihargan Yakubore besifelaiye.
Toi Yakube Išore ruṭi edde rainda mošorir ḍailor zul diye. Ar hite há fiya gori bade hentu giyegoi. Endilla gori Išye hitar foila zormor odiharganore muillo sara goijje.
